audience: vacation rental managers who manage properties and guest records in Tokeet

useCases.title: Check which rentals are available on which dates
useCases.text: The AI lists your rentals and reads the open and blocked dates of each over the next two years. You see which properties are available on a given weekend.

useCases.title: Review the rates of a rental
useCases.text: The AI reads all standard, dynamic and promotional rates of one rental, so you can compare them.

useCases.title: Look up a guest by email or name
useCases.text: The AI finds a guest by exact email or by partial name and reads contact details, notes, interactions and preferences.

useCases.title: Review, create or update tasks
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks such as cleanings and check-ins. It can create a task for a user, or rename, reschedule, reassign or complete one.

useCases.title: Review expenses by rental and category
useCases.text: The AI lists recorded expenses with date, rental, category, amount and paid status. It adds them up by rental or category.

useCases.title: Add a guest, a note or a logged interaction
useCases.text: The AI creates a guest record, adds an internal note, or logs a phone call, meeting or comment in the guest's history. Nothing is sent to the guest.
